notes.text: No guided nature walks were found for this week at Kernavė, in Neris Regional Park or in Vilnius. For a self-guided outing, try the Sapieginė nature trail in Verkiai Regional Park (5.5 km, easy), or go after dark to the Rumšiškės light festival or the Lumina light park in the VU Botanical Garden.
Elektrėnai culture centre's own calendar could not be read this week (the site blocked access), so near-home listings come from earlier checks; confirm times on the site.
Rytas basketball: home game vs Juventus on Sunday 22 Nov (LKL). European home fixtures could not be confirmed; check the club site. The A Lyga football season is over.
Advent begins on Sunday 29 November. Tree lightings: Trakai 27 Nov, Vilnius 28 Nov, Kaišiadorys 4 Dec. Elektrėnai and Vievis dates were not found; watch the municipality calendar.
